$comment: printedrobotics.cz funnel analytics: the ONLY events and properties the api accepts. Unknown events are dropped, unknown or invalid properties are dropped. Never add names, e-mails, free text, precise location or anything that identifies a person. Human-readable version: docs/analytics/events.md. A copy lives in backend/api/src/schema.json (the api's Docker build context); a test keeps them identical.

page_view.description: A page was shown (after consent). Referrer reduced to its host name; utm_* lower-cased and restricted to a safe alphabet.

sim_load_start.description: A simulator started loading its engine.

sim_loaded.description: The simulator is ready. ms = time from load start; detail = scene variant.

mission_start.description: First interaction in a fresh attempt of a mission (SO-101).

mission_win.description: A mission was completed. assisted = the planner (hint/solution) or a replay solved it.

hint_used.description: The visitor pressed a hint button. level 1 = hint in the HUD (after 20 s), 2 = hint in the mission card.

solution_shown.description: The arm planned and played the solution of the mission (hint button, demo button or shortcut).

demo_shared.description: A share link for a recorded demonstration was created.

ai_paired.description: An AI assistant was paired with the simulator tab.

ai_tool_call.description: Sampled: the first call of each tool per page view (not every call).

arena_match_end.description: An arena match ended. result is from player 1's point of view.

replay_shared.description: An arena replay was saved to a file or shared as a link.

waitlist_submit.description: The waitlist form was sent successfully. interest = the ticked options (comma list of option ids), never the e-mail.

school_lead_submit.description: The school pilot form was sent successfully (no form content is tracked).

cta_click.description: A marked call-to-action (data-cta / data-track attribute) was clicked.
